app_fee.value: Nonrefundable $75 application processing fee, paid electronically after the online application.

fee_waiver.value: The fee is waived only for Rensselaer alumni, current students, employees and employee spouses; no waiver for international applicants is listed.
fee_waiver.quote: The application fee is waived for Rensselaer alumni, current Rensselaer students (matriculating and non-matriculating), employees, and employee spouses.

gre_general.value: GRE is optional for PhD programmes except Management, which requires it.
gre_general.quote: Optional for all other degree programs.

toefl_min.value: TOEFL iBT minimum is 88 (or 4.5 on the new 6.0 scale); some departments set higher.
toefl_min.quote: TOEFL score of 88 iBT (or a 4.5 on the new 6.0 scale)

also.quote: Some departments require a higher language proficiency score than the Institute minimum.

english_waiver.value: The English test is waived only for a degree from a regionally accredited U.S. or English-speaking-country university, so an Indian degree does not qualify on this page.
english_waiver.quote: Non-Native English-speaking international applicants who have, or will have earned, an undergraduate or graduate degree from a regionally accredited university in the U.S. or country where English is the official language

also.quote: Please note that this waiver will be applied after your application has been submitted and reviewed by the Graduate Admissions Office.

notes: Checked 2026-10-26. Blocked (403): https://admissions.rpi.edu/graduate/masters-and-phd-applicants and https://gradadmissions.rpi.edu/application-instructions-and-process. The doctoral deadline and English rules come from the deadlines page. Physics and other departments may set their own TOEFL rule (see program records).
